decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship GIS platform and a publicly emphasized product line, D embodies substantial prior investment and visible strategic commitment, so management is likely to keep backing it in a growing market.

E fits closely with the firm's core geospatial integration offer and has remained visible beyond launch, so despite some uncertainty around product traction management would likely continue it rather than concede an earlier commitment.

F is tightly connected to the firm's established web-map business and showed ongoing version development after launch, which gives management a credible basis to treat any weaker results as temporary and keep it on the market.
